title: (Biographies) George Mueller
description: In this sermon, the speaker emphasizes the importance of memorizing extended passages of Scripture as a means of meditating on God's Word. He highlights the life of George Mueller, who sought to glorify God by caring for orphans and trusting in His provision. The speaker encourages listeners to "see God" and find satisfaction in Him, which will lead to freedom from greed and fear and a willingness to take risks and sacrificially love others. He concludes by emphasizing the crucial role of knowing God through the Bible and fighting for joy in Him.
